title: v2 example why AI answers change
hook: ASK AI TWICE GET TWO ANSWERS

lines: Ask AI the same question twice, and you can get two different answers.
Does that mean it is broken? No.
That is not a glitch. It is how the model is built.
It was designed to work this way, on purpose.
Each answer starts as a list of likely next words.
Every word has a score, and higher scores win more often.
But the model does not always pick the top word.
That is the catch.
It rolls weighted dice, so a close second can win.
Small chances still happen.
Run it twice, and the dice can land on different words.
Same question, same scores, different pick.
One different word early on changes everything after it.
The rest of the answer follows that word.
So two answers can both sound sure, and still disagree.
The tone never tells you which one is right.
When it matters, ask again and compare the two answers.
Agreement is a good sign. A mismatch is a warning.
If they match, good. If they do not, check a real source.
Which answer do you trust more, the first or the second?
